title: Grow With Letters
hook: Root to leaf, the garden opens for me!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one beat of quiet before confirmation
visualStyle: fresh 3D garden storybook, leaf green and flower colors, rounded plants, clean simple background and isolated subjects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child tracing the hidden-to-visible structure of a garden from soil and roots up into leaves, flowers and fruit
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: return the ear to the below-to-above growth path before the next garden layer
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: gentle 4/4 growth pulse with rising two-bar phrases
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written vertical garden imagery; use below/above, root/shoot, curl/climb/open and water/soil links, while tools and helpers keep their real non-growing functions
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: growth-position cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe shape, grow, open, pour or point gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. marimba seed-to-sprout answer figures and tiny shaker breaths
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: marimba seed-to-sprout answer figures and tiny shaker breaths
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Let the child see a garden as a living architecture: hidden roots and soil lead upward into stems, leaves, blooms, fruit and finally a whole layered bed.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A close observer keeps moving the eye down, through, around and upward; root/shoot/leaf/bloom language links the alphabet without pretending every mapped object itself grows.
semanticArc: rise through stems and climbing growth
open into flower and food shapes
step back and see the whole garden fed by water and soil
forbiddenGenericLanguage: garden words sprout up with me
